[{"insert":"Seated Strict Press

The seated strict press takes your legs out of it, letting your shoulders do all the work overhead. Sitting also stops your lower back from helping.. Keep the bar path straight up and brace your core on every rep. Pair it with push ups, which will feel harder than usual since your shoulders are already tired.
"}]
